script_text: Stop! Cancer, the stars are screaming at you right now. The Moon, your ruling planet, forms a tense square to Mars, igniting your 7th House of Partnerships and stirring emotional friction at home. As a sensitive Water sign, you are feeling everything twice, so do not let a private trigger become a public clash tonight. In love, if you are taken, Venus in your 5th House trine your Moon softens your partner's mood, so listen before reacting. If you are single, stop chasing cold energy, because a grounded Water connection appears through a trusted friend in your 11th House. In career, Jupiter in your 10th House sextile Mercury opens a money door, so pitch the idea you shelved before noon tomorrow. Blessing: an unexpected message from family heals an old wound in your 4th House before sunset tonight. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
